docsHtml:
Full configuration reference

Everything below is set on window.WhatsAppFloatingConfig (or passed to WhatsAppFloating.init(config)). All properties are optional except where noted.

Message & branding

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
messagestring""Pre-filled WhatsApp message, URL-encoded into the wa.me link. Supports {{city}}, {{state}}/{{region}}, {{country}}, {{ip}}, {{ip_base64}} placeholders, replaced with the resolved geolocation (empty string if unavailable). Also supports WhatsApp's own *bold*/_italic_/~strike~/```mono``` formatting, rendered natively by WhatsApp once the chat opens.
appendUtmToMessagebooleanfalseAppends detected utm_* query params to the message text.
ariaLabelstring"WhatsApp"aria-label on the button link.
imageAltstring"WhatsApp"alt text on the image.
iconstring (SVG)built-in glyphUsed instead of an image when no image URL resolves. See also iconVariant.
iconVariant"solid"|"roundedSquare"|"flat"|"mono"—Built-in SVG icon by name. Ignored when images/assetsBaseUrl resolve to a URL, or when pill is set. An explicit icon string also wins over this.

Images

PropertyTypeDescription
images.desktopstring (URL)Desktop button image.
images.mobilestring (URL)Mobile button image.
assetsBaseUrlstring (URL)When images is not set, defaults to ${assetsBaseUrl}/whatsapp-desktop.png and whatsapp-mobile.png.

Resolution order (highest priority first): runtime setImages() → matching rule/path rule images → top-level images → assetsBaseUrl defaults. Images load with loading="eager", decoding="async" and a preload hint — no lazy-load stall for above-the-fold UI.

Pill button — pill

Renders an icon + text button instead of an image/icon. Exclusive of images, assetsBaseUrl, icon and iconVariant.

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
pill.textstringrequiredLabel shown next to the icon.
pill.expand"hover"|"always"|"click"|"never""hover"When the text label is visible. "hover" reveals on mouse-over. "always" keeps it expanded. "click" reveals on 1st tap, opens WhatsApp on 2nd. "never" stays icon-only (text used as accessible label).
pill.expandMobile"hover"|"always"|"click"|"never"same as expandOverride expand at/below mobileBreakpoint. Useful for "hover on desktop, always on mobile" patterns.
pill.iconicon key | SVG string"solid"Icon inside the pill — same choices as iconVariant.
pill.colorstring (CSS colour)"#25D366"Pill background colour.
pill.textColorstring (CSS colour)"#ffffff"Label text colour.
pill.fontSizenumber (px)14Font size of the label.
pill.fontWeightnumber | string600CSS font-weight of the label (e.g. 400, 700).
pill.paddingRightnumber (px)18Horizontal padding between the label and the right edge.
pill.borderRadiusnumber (px)999Border radius. Use 0 for square, 4–16 for rounded-rectangle, 999 for fully-rounded.

Location rules — rules[]

Matching priority: City → State → Country → Fallback. Within each level, the first rule that matches wins.

PropertyTypeDescription
countrystringCountry code/name to match.
statestringRegion/state to match.
city / citiesstring | string[]One or more cities (case/accent-insensitive).
phonestringFixed number for this rule.
numbers{phone, weight?}[]Multiple numbers — use with distribution.
distribution"random"|"roundrobin"|"weighted"How to pick among numbers. Default "random".
images{desktop?, mobile?}Overrides the button image when this rule matches.
messagestringOverrides the wa.me ?text= message when this rule matches. Falls back to the top-level message if omitted.
schedulesee Scheduling belowRule only matches within business hours/days.
utmsee UTM belowRule only matches for a given campaign.
languagestringMatches if the browser language starts with this value.
referrerstringMatches if document.referrer contains this substring.
domainstringMatches if location.hostname contains this substring.
pagestringMatches if the URL path contains this substring.
continent"AF"|"AS"|"EU"|"NA"|"SA"|"OC"|"AN"Matches for that continent (derived from country).

Distribution strategies

When a rule (or pathRules/fallback) has multiple numbers instead of a single phone, distribution decides which one gets picked each time the widget resolves:

StrategyHow it picks
"random" (default)Picks one number at random, equal probability for all, every time the widget loads.
"roundrobin"Cycles through numbers in order (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 1st, …), advancing one position per resolution. The position counter only lives in memory for the current page session — not persisted to localStorage, not shared across visitors/tabs — so it resets on every full page reload. Aliases: "round-robin", "round_robin".
"weighted"Random pick, but numbers with a higher weight are proportionally more likely. weight defaults to 1 when omitted — e.g. {phone:"A",weight:2},{phone:"B"} gives "A" a 2-in-3 chance.

Path rules — pathRules[]

Evaluated before location rules — can override phone and/or images regardless of the visitor's location. Useful for campaign landing pages (e.g. /promocao).

PropertyTypeDescription
pathstringSubstring the current pathname must contain.
pathRegexstringRegular expression (no slashes) tested against the pathname.
phone / numbers / distributionsame as location rulesIf omitted, phone falls through to rules/fallback.
images{desktop?, mobile?}Applied even if phone is omitted.
messagestringOverrides the wa.me ?text= message when this path rule matches. Applied even if phone is omitted.
schedule, utmsame as location rulesExtra conditions for the path rule to match.

Fallback

fallback: { phone: "5511999999999" } — or numbers/distribution like above. Used when no pathRules/rules match. fallback.message works the same way. Message resolution is independent from phone/image resolution.

Scheduling

schedule: { days: [...], hours: { start: "09:00", end: "18:00" }, timezone: "America/Manaus" } — attach to any rule to restrict it to business hours/days. Overnight ranges (e.g. 22:00–06:00) are supported. timezone is an optional IANA name; defaults to browser local time.

UTM campaign matching

utm: { source: "google", medium: "cpc" } — matches against utm_source, utm_medium, etc. query params on the landing URL.

Manual location override

location: { country: "BR", state: "AM", city: "Manaus" } — skips the geolocation API entirely.

Geolocation

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
geoApiUrlstring—Custom primary geolocation endpoint, tried first.
geoProvidersstring[]—Additional endpoints appended to the fallback chain.
geoTimeoutnumber (ms)5000Per-provider timeout before moving to the next one.
cacheLocationbooleanfalseCache the resolved location in localStorage. Off by default so the widget always resolves in real time (e.g. across VPN/network switches).
geoCacheTTLnumber (ms)21600000 (6h)Cache lifetime (only applies when cacheLocation is true); 0 disables expiry.

Built-in fallback chain: ipapi.co → ipwho.is → ip-api.com → ipinfo.io → ip.oxylabs.io. Only one HTTP request is made per page load (subject to caching); the chain only tries the next provider if one actually fails. When cacheLocation is true, that same request is also used to detect IP changes (e.g. VPN) and refresh the cache automatically.

Remote configuration

remoteConfigUrl: a JSON URL fetched and deep-merged into the local config before initializing — update rules/phones without redeploying the script tag.

Layout & positioning

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
position"bottom-right"|"bottom-left"|"custom""bottom-right"Corner the button is anchored to. Only the two bottom corners are offered as keywords (a floating WhatsApp button is conventionally bottom-anchored); use "custom" to anchor to the top or control each side independently via offset.
offset.top/.bottom/.left/.rightnumber | string25 (px)Distance from the anchored corner(s). Numbers = px; strings accept any CSS length.
mobileBreakpointnumber768Viewport width (px) at/below which mobile is assumed.
zIndexnumber2147483647Stacking order.
theme.iconSizenumber | string64pxIcon/image height on desktop. Numbers = px; strings accept any CSS length ("4rem", "10%").
theme.iconSizeMobilenumber | string56pxIcon/image height at/below mobileBreakpoint. Defaults independently so setting only one still gives a responsive size.
theme.shadowbooleanfalseAdds a drop shadow behind the image.
theme.roundedbooleanfalseRounds the image's corners.
theme.darkbooleanfalseHeavier shadow when combined with theme.shadow.
theme.pulseboolean | PulseConfigfalsetrue enables the icon scale/breathing animation with defaults (≡ { scale: true }). Pass a PulseConfig object to also enable a ring/halo or tune timing/appearance.
cssstring—Raw CSS appended after the library's own styles.

Mobile is detected when window.innerWidth <= mobileBreakpoint OR the URL path contains "/mobile". The image never exceeds 90vw and keeps its natural aspect ratio — no cropping, no forced circle/square.

Pulse animation — PulseConfig

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
pulse.scalebooleantrue when pulse is setIcon scale ("breathing") animation — gently grows and shrinks in a loop.
pulse.ringbooleanfalseExpanding coloured ring/halo around the button. Composes cleanly with scale.
pulse.durationnumber (ms)1800Animation cycle length, shared by both effects.
pulse.scaleAmountnumber1.08Peak scale factor for the breathing effect.
pulse.colorstring"#25D366"Ring colour.
pulse.opacitynumber0.55Ring starting opacity (fades to 0 as it expands).

Analytics

analytics: true (default) auto-pushes render/open events to Google Analytics (gtag.js), Google Tag Manager (dataLayer) and Meta Pixel (fbq) if those globals are present — no extra configuration needed.

Debug / production

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
debugbooleanfalseVerbose console logging for every internal step.
productionbooleantrueWhen true and debug is false, suppresses the console summary.
lazyLoadbooleanfalseDefer initialization until the load event.

Events

EventPayloadFired when
onReady{phone, location, matched}The button has been rendered and is ready.
onLocation{country, state, city}Geolocation has resolved.
onPhoneSelected{phone, matched}A phone number has been chosen.
onOpen{phone}The button was clicked (or .open() called).
onClose{phone}.close() was called.

matched is one of "Path"|"Cidade"|"Estado"|"País"|"Fallback"|"Manual". Every event also dispatches as a document-level CustomEvent named whatsappfloating:<event>.

Public API

Available on window.WhatsAppFloating (global build) or as the default export (npm build).

WhatsAppFloating.init(config);          // (re)initialize with a full config
WhatsAppFloating.reload(partialConfig?); // re-run resolution, optionally merging new config
WhatsAppFloating.open();                // open the wa.me link programmatically
WhatsAppFloating.close();               // hide the button
WhatsAppFloating.destroy();             // remove the button from the DOM
WhatsAppFloating.getPhone();            // -> string | null
WhatsAppFloating.getLocation();         // -> { country, state, city }
WhatsAppFloating.getMatched();          // -> matched level | null
WhatsAppFloating.setPhone(phone);       // override the phone number at runtime
WhatsAppFloating.setImages(images);     // override desktop/mobile images at runtime
WhatsAppFloating.getImages();           // -> the currently resolved { desktop, mobile }
WhatsAppFloating.isReady();             // -> boolean
WhatsAppFloating.on(event, fn);         // subscribe to an event without touching config
WhatsAppFloating.off(event, fn);        // unsubscribe

Default assets

Two PNGs by convention — whatsapp-desktop.png and whatsapp-mobile.png — hosted anywhere and referenced via assetsBaseUrl. Always overridable globally via images, per rule/path via each rule's images, or at runtime via setImages().
